analysis.task_statement: The user wanted to figure out, and have built, a way for the intropy-cli dashboard to let developers inspect message contracts for messages flowing through a system. Internal events are always CloudEvents on a known channel, so their contract can be derived from the .NET message type (rendered as field names, hierarchy and required-ness, not C# source). External messages (e.g. flat files from SFTP) rarely have a spec, so the dashboard needs some way to describe and surface those too. The session ended with a working implementation in the Go CLI and web dashboard, verified by go tests and an npm build.

The user wants to clarify rather than pick one of the offered multiple-choice options.
